text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day was right around the 
corner. I had always thought of it as a 
day that had nothing to do with me, but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...That concludes all the packages 
addressed to you, Trainer.

What Tazuna brought over was a massive 
stack of cardboard boxes... Apparently, 
all of them were filled with Valentine's 
gifts.
choice_data_list: W-Why so much...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I believe that is all thanks to your own 
personal virtues, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, it likely reflects the 
recognition she's earned alongside you, 
Mejiro Ramonu... and more so, the 
expectations for what lies ahead.
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.text:
Whatever ulterior motives there might be, 
it's a fact that I received their sincere 
feelings. In that case, I want to properly 
return the favor.
choice_data_list:
(If I'm going to do it, I want to tailor 
it to each and every one of them.)

text_block_list.text:
So, when we came to a department store 
with multiple brands to choose from—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hello.
choice_data_list: Hello.

text_block_list.text:
I know she shops at department stores, but 
seeing her by the sweets section feels 
somehow unusual...
choice_data_list: Does Ramonu have Valentine's plans too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yeah. No, I just dropped by.

Judging by this reaction, Valentine's Day 
hadn't even crossed her mind to begin 
with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You seem busy.

Hearing that reminded me that I was 
holding an enormous pile of bags.
choice_data_list: Yeah, the truth is—
Um, actually——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. A Valentine's return gift, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How conscientious. Though, you could 
simply pick the finest item and give it to 
everyone.
choice_data_list: That one's nice too, but...

text_block_list.text:
"If I was going to do it, I wanted to act 
with true consideration for the other 
person. Choosing something tailored to 
their tastes and image conveys feelings 
far beyond mere courtesy."
choice_data_list:
Well, it'll take that much more time, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The rest of the list. May I take a look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Here you are.

When I handed Mejiro Ramonu the list, she 
spent some time writing something on it. 
Looking at it once she handed it back—
choice_data_list: Is this... a sweets brand name?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The items that Baaya used to give to those 
people in the past.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know anyone I don't associate 
with."

Though there were blank spots, most seemed 
to be people she already knew. Choosing 
from this list would save a lot of time. 
It's appreciated, but—
choice_data_list: So you'll help me?
Will you help me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I only told you what you already knew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I don't want to give you any 
more of my time.
choice_data_list:
...I'll spend whatever free time I have 
left with you.

...I shall devote any remaining time to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Please do not state the obvious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I will see you on the course, then. Good 
day.

And so, thanks to the list Mejiro Ramonu 
had added to, I was able to pick out a 
satisfying return gift in no time.
choice_data_list: (I want to thank her... That's it.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —So, you picked out one for me too.
choice_data_list: I went with chocolate with nuts.
I went with chocolate with nuts!

text_block_list.text:
I rarely see her indulging in snacks. Even 
so, searching my memory of our breaks, I 
recalled that she often snacked on nuts.
choice_data_list:
I thought it'd be perfect for replenishing 
your nutrients

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I shall gladly accept.
choice_data_list: No, thank you as always!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: I've learned so much from you.
I've learned so much from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I learned something from you today as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Feelings that go beyond mere politeness... 
...Yes, they certainly reach you.

And so, thanks to the list Mejiro Ramonu 
had added to, I was able to pick out a 
satisfying return gift in no time.
choice_data_list:
(I want to thank her, too, but... first 
things first.)

text_block_list.text:
As promised, all spare time was dedicated 
to analyzing upcoming races and 
researching training methods. As a result—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...How was it?
choice_data_list:
Your final stretch was faster than last 
time!

Your final stretch was faster than last 
time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see... Hehe.

It's only natural she's pleased. Shaving 
time off after reaching full growth is no 
easy feat. Yet she undeniably managed to 
beat her record.
choice_data_list: That's incredible!
Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That's all for today's menu. Good work.
choice_data_list: Ah, wait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What is it?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to thank you for the other day, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I've already received it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: To this body. —A wonderful gift in return.
